content: प्रति {%ind.%} .²1 As a prefix to verbs it means .³({%a%}) towards, in the direction of; .³({%b%}) back, in return, again; तिष्ठेदानीं न मे जीवन् प्रतियास्यसि दुर्मते <ls>Rām. 7. 18. 13</ls>; .³({%c%}) in opposition to, against, counter; .³({%d%}) upon, down upon; (see the several roots with this preposition). .²2 As a prefix to nouns not directly derived from verbs it means .³({%a%}) likeness, resemblance, equality; .³({%b%}) opposite, of the opposite side; प्रतिबल <ls>Ve. 3. 5</ls> ‘the opposing force’; so प्रतिद्विपाः <ls>Mu. 2. 13</ls>; .³({%c%}) rivalry; as in प्रतिचन्द्रः ‘a rival moon’; प्रतिपुरुषः <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 As a separable preposition (with <ab>acc.</ab>) it means .³({%a%}) towards, in the direction of, to; तौ दम्पती स्वां प्रति राजधानीं प्रस्थापयामास वशी वसिष्ठः <ls>R. 2. 70</ls>, <ls n="R.">1. 75</ls>; प्रत्यनिलं विचेरु <ls>Ku. 3. 31</ls>; वृक्षं प्रति विद्योतते विद्युत् <ls>Sk.</ls>; .³({%b%}) against, counter, in opposition to, opposite; तदा यायाद् रिपुं प्रति <ls>Ms. 7. 171</ls>; प्रदुद्रुवुस्तं प्रति राक्षसेन्द्रम् <ls>Rām.</ls>; ययावजः प्रत्यरिसैन्यमेव <ls>R. 7. 55</ls>; .³({%c%}) in comparison with, on a par with, in proportion to, a match for; त्वं सहस्राणि प्रति <ls>Rv. 2. 1. 8</ls>; .³({%d%}) near, in the vicinity of, by, at, in, on; समासेदुस्ततो गङ्गां शृङ्गवेरपुरं प्रति <ls>Rām.</ls>; गङ्गां प्रति; .³({%e%}) at the time, about, during; आदित्यस्योदयं प्रति <ls>Mb.</ls>; फाल्गुनं वाथ चैत्रं वा मासौ प्रति <ls>Ms. 7. 182</ls>; .³({%f%}) on the side of, in favour of, to the lot of; यदत्र मां प्रति स्यात् <ls>Sk.</ls>; हरं प्रति हलाहलं (अभवत्) <ls>Vop.</ls>; .³({%g%}) in each, in or at every, severally (used in a distributive sense); वर्षं प्रति, प्रतिवर्षम्; यज्ञं प्रति <ls>Y. 1. 110</ls>; वृक्षं वृक्षं प्रति सिञ्चति <ls>Sk.</ls>; .³({%h%}) with regard or reference to, in relation to, regarding, concerning, about, as to; न हि मे संशीतिरस्या दिव्यतां प्रति <ls>K. 132</ls>; चन्द्रोपरागं प्रति तु केनापि विप्रलब्धासि <ls>Mu. 1</ls>; धर्मं प्रति <ls>Ś. 5. 18</ls>; मन्दौत्सुक्योऽस्मि नगरगमनं प्रति <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; <ls>Ku. 6. 27</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">7. 83</ls>; त्वयैकमीशं प्रति साधु भाषितभ् <ls n="Ku.">5. 81</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 218</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 12</ls>, <ls n="R.">10. 29</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 51</ls>; .³({%i%}) according to, in conformity with; मां प्रति in my opinion; .³({%j%}) before, in the presence of; .³({%k%}) for, on account of. .²4 As a separable preposition (with <ab>abl.</ab>) it means either .³({%a%}) a representative of, in place of, instead of; प्रद्युम्नः कृष्णात् प्रति <ls>Sk.</ls>; संग्रामे यो नारायणतः प्रति <ls>Bk. 8. 89</ls>; or .³({%b%}) in exchange or return for; तिलेभ्यः प्रति यच्छति माषान् <ls>Sk.</ls>; भक्तेः प्रत्यमृतं शंभोः <ls>Vop.</ls> .²5 As the first member of Avyayībhāva compound it usually means .³({%a%}) in or at every; as प्रतिसंवत्सरम् ‘every year’, प्रतिक्षणम्, प्रत्यहम् <ab>&c.</ab>; .³({%b%}) towards, in the direction of; प्रत्यग्नि शलभा डयन्ते. .²6 प्रति is sometimes used as the last member of <ab>Avyayī. comp.</ab> in the sense of ‘a little’; सूपप्रति, शाकप्रति. [{%Note%}:-- In the compounds given below all words the second members of which are words not immediately connected with verbs, are included; other words will be found in their proper places.]
